title: The Holiday Entertaining Plant Board
seo_title: Vegan Holiday Charcuterie Board for 10–14: Shopping List & Plan
description: A plant-based holiday board for 10–14: herbed cashew cheese, vegan brie, cranberry walnut spread, pears, figs, pomegranate and roasted chestnuts.
hook: A full holiday spread for a mixed crowd, with nothing on it that a vegan guest has to avoid.
why: Holiday boards are about abundance and colour, and both are easy without dairy or meat. Pomegranate, cranberries and red pears against green rosemary give the red-and-green look, and roasted chestnuts are the one ingredient everyone connects with December.

Three nut cheeses cover the textures a dairy board would: a spreadable herbed one, a sweet cranberry-walnut one, and a vegan brie. Whole-grain mustard and a thread of pomegranate molasses bring the acid that keeps the rich spreads from getting heavy.

timeline.what: Take out the nut cheeses and let them rest.
Slice the pears, halve the figs, fill the bowls.
Build the cracker structure; cluster the nuts.
Add the dried fruit and chestnuts.
Rosemary, pomegranate and a drizzle of molasses.

faq.q: Is this holiday board fully vegan?
faq.a: Yes. Every item is plant-based. Check labels on crackers and candied nuts, which can contain butter or honey.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 10 to 14 people as an appetizer, on a 20–24 inch board.
That's the point: it's a full holiday board that happens to be plant-based, so it works for the whole table.
